---
title: "Analyzing School District Reading Scores"
author: "Genesis E"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = "data/seda_2025.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)
dbplyr_dist <- tbl(con, "district_scores")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")

district_scores_2015 <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, rla_2015 = rla_score)
district_scores_2023 <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, rla_2023 = rla_score)
score_change <- inner_join(
  district_scores_2015,
  district_scores_2023,
  by = c("district_id", "district_name", "state")
) |>
  mutate(rla_change = rla_2023 - rla_2015) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, rla_change) |>
  collect()
print(score_change)

state_scores <- tbl(con, "state_scores")
state_scores_2015 <- state_scores |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, rla_2015 = rla_score)
state_scores_2023 <- state_scores |>
  filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, rla_2023 = rla_score)
state_change <- inner_join(
  state_scores_2015,
  state_scores_2023,
  by = c("stateabb", "state_name")
) |>
  mutate(score_change = rla_2023 - rla_2015) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, rla_2015, rla_2023, score_change) |>
  collect()
print(state_change)
```

```{r}
score_change |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = rla_change,
    fill = case_when(
      rla_change > 0 ~ "Positive",
      rla_change < 0 ~ "Negative",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    )
  )) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Negative" = "#d95f02", "No change" = "#7570b3", "Positive" = "#1b9e77")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of District Reading Score Changes",
    subtitle = paste("Districts with data in both years:", scales::comma(nrow(score_change))),
    x = "Change in reading score (2023 - 2015)",
    y = "Number of districts",
    fill = "Change",
    caption = "Positive values indicate improvement; the dashed line marks no change."
  )
```

```{r}
state_change |>
  mutate(
    state_name = fct_reorder(state_name, rla_2023),
    direction = case_when(
      score_change > 0 ~ "Improved",
      score_change < 0 ~ "Declined",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = state_name)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = rla_2015, xend = rla_2023, yend = state_name, color = direction),
    arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(0.12, "inches"), type = "closed"),
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = rla_2015), color = "gray60", size = 1.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Declined" = "#d95f02",
    "No change" = "#7570b3",
    "Improved" = "#1b9e77"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "State Reading Scores: 2015 to 2023",
    subtitle = "States are ordered by their 2023 reading score",
    x = "Reading score",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Direction of change",
    caption = "Gray dots mark 2015 scores; arrows point to 2023 scores."
  )
```
